distribution.baseline: USD probability .65; amount lognormal(log(1000),.4), INR scaled by 70
distribution.status: settled .75, pending .20, failed .05, unchanged across all scenarios
distribution.no_shift: Independent draws from identical conditional laws and currency mix
distribution.amount_shift: Candidate amount multiplier 2.5 in each currency; unchanged mix
distribution.currency_mix: Candidate USD probability .15; unchanged conditional amount/status laws

caveat: Independent synthetic trials; no source population or production accuracy guarantee. No-shift alarm rate is the observed false-positive rate for this generator and policy; target detection means amount alarm or currency-mix alarm respectively. Wilson intervals quantify Monte Carlo trial-rate uncertainty, not CDC significance. Finite samples can trigger unrelated metrics; all metric alarms are retained.
